highlights.description: Regenerated `oag7/aha` client (OpenAPI Generator 7.24.0), greatly expanding the API surface: Comments, Epics, Goals, Initiatives, Requirements, Strategic Models, Workflows, Custom Field Definitions, and Users, plus Create/Update/Delete across entities
Fixes `aha ideas list` failing with "no value given for required property votes": the Idea `votes` field is now optional, matching Aha's list endpoint which omits it by default

added.description: `oag7/aha`: Comments, Epics, Goals, Initiatives, Requirements, Strategic Models, Workflows, Custom Fields, and Users API services, with Create/Update/Delete operations across entities

fixed.description: `aha ideas list` no longer errors when the API response omits `votes`; `Idea.votes` is now an optional pointer

changed.description: Optional and nullable fields are now pointers (`*string`) or `NullableString` instead of value types; use the generated `GetX()` accessors

removed.description: `oag7/examples` programs (features_get, idea_feature_release), which duplicated the SDK quick start

documentation.description: OpenAPI client regeneration guide under docs/development
Refreshed README Supported APIs table for the expanded client

build.description: Switch client generation input to the YAML OpenAPI spec
Stop tracking generated MkDocs site output

highlights.description: New Cobra CLI for interacting with Aha! API from the command line
Comprehensive idea-feature-release reporting with multiple output formats

added.description: CLI: Cobra CLI with commands for ideas, features, products, releases, and reports
CLI: `--inflate` flag to fetch full idea details including categories
CLI: `--fail-on-error` flag for strict feature fetch error handling
CLI: Progress bar during idea inflation
SDK: `IdeaFeatureReport` and `IdeaFeatureReportSet` for comprehensive idea-feature-release reporting
SDK: `GetIdeaFeatureReports()` with automatic pagination via `FetchAll` option

fixed.description: `CustomField.Value` now supports any type (string, array, etc.) matching actual Aha! API responses
`Idea` model fields (`categories`, `votes`, timestamps) are now optional to handle varying API responses

documentation.description: MkDocs documentation site with Getting Started, CLI Reference, SDK Guide, and Examples
README updated with quick start, API reference table, and corrected examples
